raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The latest batches have started carrying reversals as separate 'REVERSAL' rows whose orig_txn_id points to the original transaction, and those originals are still marked POSTED. Earlier reversals changed the original's status to 'REVERSED'. silver_transactions keeps the POSTED originals that have been reversed, so recent gold totals are higher than the settlement file.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reversed_txn_ids AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) AS orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reversed_txn_ids v WHERE v.orig_txn_id = CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT))"}}
